tools.name: verify_links
tools.description: Check up to 10 URLs before citing or sending them. Per URL: verdict (live, live_but_text_not_found, soft_404, parked, dead, blocked_or_rate_limited, unreachable), HTTP status, final URL, title, and optional check that an expected phrase appears. Price: 0.005 USDC per call (x402, Base).

tools.name: verify_citations
tools.description: Verify up to 10 citations really exist and match the claimed title/authors/year, against Crossref, DataCite, arXiv and PubMed. Items: DOI, arXiv id, 'PMID: 123', free-text reference, or {doi|arxiv|pmid|title, authors, year}. Verdicts: verified, mismatch, not_found, error. Price: 0.01 USDC per call (

tools.name: find_archive
tools.description: For up to 10 URLs (e.g. dead links), find the closest Internet Archive Wayback Machine snapshot, optionally nearest a date (YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD). Returns snapshot URL, capture time, captured status. Price: 0.005 USDC per call (x402, Base).

tools.name: check_headers
tools.description: Inspect security headers for up to 5 URLs: HSTS, CSP, clickjacking protection, cookie flags (names only, never values), Server/X-Powered-By disclosure, HTTPS redirect, a simple letter grade and plain recommendations. HEAD is used first, with a small GET if needed. No TLS certificate handshake. Price

tools.name: site_policies
tools.description: Fetch robots.txt, llms.txt, llms-full.txt, ai.txt and /.well-known/security.txt for up to 5 sites. Parses AI-crawler rules (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, CCBot, PerplexityBot, …) and whether a given path is allowed, lists sitemap URLs, and parses security.txt contact/expiry. Price: 0.005 USDC

tools.name: email_auth
tools.description: Check SPF, DMARC, MX and common DKIM selectors for up to 5 domains via DNS-over-HTTPS. Reports policy strength, common misconfigs (multiple SPF, SPF lookup limit, +all, p=none), a simple grade and recommendations. Mailbox existence is never probed. Not a deliverability or safety guarantee. Price: 0.

tools.name: injection_scan
tools.description: Rule-based scan of a text blob (max 50 KB) for prompt-injection patterns: instruction overrides, role hijack, hidden unicode, base64 payloads, tool/webhook exfil, markdown image exfil. Returns risk, matches with offsets, and a sanitized copy marked untrusted. Heuristic only; text is not stored. Pric

tools.name: wiki_summary
tools.description: Short Wikipedia extract for up to 3 titles or search queries (optional lang). Returns extract, URL, thumbnail, Wikidata id and CC BY-SA 4.0 attribution. Price: 0.005 USDC per call (x402, Base).

tools.name: license_detect
tools.description: Identify a common SPDX license (MIT, Apache-2.0, GPL, LGPL, AGPL, BSD, MPL-2.0, ISC, Unlicense, CC0, …) from license text or a public LICENSE file URL. Returns confidence and key permissions/conditions. Not legal advice. Price: 0.003 USDC per call (x402, Base).

tools.name: ics_parse
tools.description: Parse iCalendar (ICS) text or a public .ics URL. Returns VEVENTs (summary, start/end in UTC/ISO, location) with RRULE expanded to at most 50 occurrences in a bounded window. Data is not stored. Price: 0.003 USDC per call (x402, Base).

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "check_headers" references sensitive artifacts (cookie). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Inspect security headers for up to 5 URLs: HSTS, CSP, clickjacking protection, cookie flags (names only, never values), Server/X-Powered-By disclosure, HTTPS re…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: verify_links, check_headers, site_policies, email_auth, wiki_summary · Private data: site_policies, license_detect · Public sink: email_auth, injection_scan.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: verify_links, check_headers, site_policies, email_auth, wiki_summary · Private data: site_policies, license_detect · Public sink: email_auth, injection_scan

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
